'''Lythos VI''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Lythos system/Legends|Lythos system]], located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was one of four major [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]] in the Lythos [[Star system/Legends|system]], the others being [[Lythos VII]], [[Lythos VIII|VIII]], and [[Lythos Nine|IX]]. Like the rest of the system, Lythos VI was located on the confluence of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Trianii Shunt]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lythos VI was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. ''The Essential Atlas'' placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
